collision_boundary.C222: C222 is a second-order double-integrator switching problem without curvature-bounded SE(2) geometry.
collision_boundary.C270: C270 is Heisenberg sub-Riemannian control with reversible horizontal velocity rather than a forward-only car.
collision_boundary.C305: C305 has convex first-order velocity balls and constant wind; C310 has nonholonomic heading and bang-straight-bang synthesis.

model.boundary_data: two oriented poses; Euclidean invariance fixes the initial pose at (0,0,0)
model.dynamics: xdot=cos(theta), ydot=sin(theta), abs(thetadot)<=1/R, forward motion only

nonclaims: Endpoint-optimal controlled arcs are not asserted to be intrinsic primitive periodic orbits.
Pontryagin's Hamiltonian is a source control device, not a Hilbert--Polya operator.
No target arithmetic datum, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, divisor law, functional equation, or zero match is asserted.

references.role: original Dubins bounded-curvature theorem and historical ownership

theorem_contract.formulas: all six normalized segment triples, feasibility discriminants, degeneracies, and ties are retained
theorem_contract.replay: integrating every feasible word returns the prescribed pose
theorem_contract.scaling: multiplying positions and R by s multiplies every length by s
theorem_contract.symmetry: reflection interchanges L and R and negates y and heading
theorem_contract.synthesis: a global minimizer exists among LSL, RSR, LSR, RSL, RLR, and LRL
